title: Chapter 85 Jiangbei Breaks Through
content:
Chapter 85 Jiangbei Breaks Through

At this time, Yu Qingfeng suddenly appeared in front of everyone.

When someone saw Yu Qingfeng, they were about to speak.

A breath of the God Lord Realm suddenly surged out of Yu Qingfeng's body.

"Everyone, leave the range of Wushen Mountain, otherwise, you will bear the consequences!"

Accompanied by the voice of the God Lord Realm's coercion.

Everyone was shocked. This was actually a terrifying existence of the God Lord Realm!

Suddenly, countless people began to retreat in a hurry.

This is a strong man in the God Lord Realm. What he said was like an imperial decree. No one dared to object.

In less than a while, Yu Qingfeng was the only one left at the foot of Wushen Mountain.

At the original place, Yu Qingfeng stood at the foot of the mountain, looking at the top of the mountain with a solemn expression.

"Jiang Bei, you must succeed."

At this time on the top of the mountain.

Lu Daosheng looked at Jiang Bei in front of him with a smile.

"I will hit you hard. If I accidentally kill you, don't blame me."

Hearing this, Jiang Bei nodded.

"If you can, please go all out, senior."

At this moment, Jiang Bei had already understood that the person in front of him was a terrifying strong man far beyond himself.

But even so, he still hoped to fight with him.

It's a pity that the strength is really too different.

So it's enough to take one blow.

Hearing Jiang Bei's words, Lu Daosheng laughed in his heart.

If I go all out, I'll have made a wasted trip. I'm not interested in corpses.

But Lu Daosheng didn't say it, maybe because he was afraid of hitting Jiang Bei, or maybe for other reasons.

"Okay, then come on."

As soon as the voice fell, Jiang Bei looked at Lu Daosheng with an extremely solemn expression, and his aura gradually soared to the peak. The pressure of the peak of the God Lord Realm continued to pour down at this moment, shaking the entire Wushen Mountain.

"Get ready, I'm going to take action."

"I'm really going to take action."

"Here it comes."

Jiang Bei: Hurry up! ! !

At this time, Jiang Bei looked at Lu Daosheng with a sullen face. If he hadn't been defeated, he would have already cursed.

And Lu Daosheng looked at Jiang Bei, feeling a little helpless.

He was thinking about how to beat Jiang Bei.

If he hit too lightly, the other party might think that he looked down on him, and it might be a waste of time.

But if he hit too hard, he was afraid that it would be counterproductive.

Oh, forget it, just use one ten-thousandth of your strength.

Whether Jiang Bei lives or dies depends on his own life.

Then, Lu Daosheng narrowed his eyes slightly, and the power in his body began to circulate slightly.

I saw that this power was extremely mysterious, and no matter what power touched this power, it would be assimilated and absorbed.

And this is the unique power of the strong in the true self realm after finding themselves.

The power of self.

Really cultivate yourself to the extreme and find your true self.

The next moment, a terrifying power flew out of Lu Daosheng's hand and rushed straight to Jiang Bei.

Seeing that power, Jiang Bei's pupils shrank. Facing that power, he felt a kind of despair from the depths of his heart.

He couldn't stop it at all.

When this thought came out, Jiang Bei's face was ferocious.

He was actually afraid!

How could the God of War be afraid!

"I am the God of War, I should not be afraid of anything!"

Bang!

Jiang Bei took a step forward suddenly, and the entire God of War Mountain broke into two pieces.

Then Jiang Bei punched out.

It was the same move he used against Lu Daosheng last time, but this time, it was much stronger than the last time.

Boom!

Another deafening roar sounded.

A figure suddenly flew out from the God of War Mountain, and at the same time, the entire God of War Mountain completely collapsed.

This movement attracted the attention of all the strong men in the entire Wuling Star Region.

This terrifying power?

Is it an existence above the God Lord Realm? !

That is the direction of the God of War Mountain, is it? !

Suddenly, countless powerful auras came from all directions and rushed towards the direction of Wushen Mountain.

At the foot of Wushen Mountain, Yu Qingfeng stared at the top of the mountain in disbelief.

At this time, Wushen Mountain no longer existed.

That figure was undoubtedly Jiang Bei.

Facing Lu Daosheng's power, Jiang Bei was defeated without a trace of suspense.

And looking at Jiang Bei who was blown away, Yu Qingfeng was not too surprised, as if he had expected it.

He was shocked only by Lu Daosheng's power.

He had never seen that power before, but it was unprecedentedly powerful.

Is this the existence above the God Lord Realm?

In the void.

Lu Daosheng slowly fell from the air and came to Yu Qingfeng's side.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Yu Qingfeng hesitated for a moment, and then bowed to Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"The name of the God of War is not false."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yu Qingfeng was relieved.

Even Lu Daosheng said so, which means Jiang Bei succeeded.

At this time, in a mountain range far away from here.

A bloody man with cracks all over his body and blood flowing continuously was lying on the ground miserably.

Everything around was destroyed by an unknown force.

Jiang Bei.

Lying on the ground, Jiang Bei slowly opened his eyes, looked up at the sky, and murmured: "So that's it, so that's it."

At this moment, he finally understood why he stopped where he was and couldn't move forward.

Got it, everything was clear.

Then, Jiang Bei suddenly laughed wildly.

The laughter was loud, and along with Jiang Bei's breath, it soon spread throughout the entire Wuling Star Region.

Such an arrogant laughter is extremely distinguishable.

Countless practitioners heard it and reacted instantly.

It's the God of War!

At this time, Jiang Bei's breath suddenly began to surge wildly.

Not only the realm, but also Jiang Bei's martial arts realm.

At this moment, Jiang Bei's martial arts realm once again took a step forward, and it was a big step.

According to Lu Daosheng's idea, the current Jiang Bei is qualified to become a God of War, a real God of War!

If Jiang Bei at this moment faces his former self, he can easily defeat the opponent with just one blow.

Boom!

With a buzzing sound.

A breath that is countless times stronger than the God Lord realm suddenly surged out of Jiang Bei's body.

God Emperor realm!

Boom boom boom! !

At this moment, the entire Wuling Star Region was boiling.

God Emperor realm, a God Emperor realm strongman appeared in the Wuling Star Region! !

Countless practitioners laughed loudly after feeling this breath, and shouted the name of the God of War.

The God of War in the Divine Emperor Realm, this gold content is extremely terrifying.

And the entire Wuling Star Region will rise because of the God of War Jiangbei.

At the same time, in some powerful star regions that are extremely far away from here, terrifying beings have awakened and looked towards the direction of the Wuling Star Region.

Endless years have passed, and there is another powerful God Emperor.

In a magnificent palace, a beautiful woman felt the breath, suddenly opened her eyes, and then looked in that direction.

However, when she saw that it was in that direction, a touch of complexity and guilt flashed in the woman's eyes.

After a moment of silence, the woman slowly closed her eyes.

Wuling Star Region.

After Jiangbei broke through to the Divine Emperor Realm, his injuries began to recover rapidly.

Mainly because Lu Daosheng had no hostility, the self-power did not erode Jiang Bei's soul, but dissipated in an instant.

Otherwise, the trace of self-power remaining in Jiang Bei's body would make Jiang Bei miserable until he died.

The original location of Wushen Mountain.

Lu Daosheng and Yu Qingfeng stood quietly waiting for Jiang Bei.

In less than a moment, a figure came from a distance and soon appeared in front of the two.

At this time, Jiang Bei looked at Lu Daosheng with a deep sense of gratitude.

If it weren't for Lu Daosheng, he might have stopped here for the rest of his life.
